intent: PSI-044: Implement ICS subscription feed route and token rotation UI.
summary: Implemented /api/calendar/feed/[token] endpoint using createServiceClient to resolve feed tokens and call events_for_user RPC, generating RFC 5545 VCALENDAR feeds via ics. Added getCalendarFeedTokenAction and rotateCalendarFeedTokenAction server actions, and built CalendarFeedDialog in the calendar header for feed URL copying and token rotation.

changes.note: Added feed token fetch and rotation actions
Modal dialog for feed subscription and token rotation

decisions.decision: Use server-only createServiceClient() to access calendar_feed_tokens and events_for_user
decisions.reason: ICS subscription route is unauthenticated by design and calendar_feed_tokens/events_for_user are restricted to service_role.

verification.manual: Verified ICS feed generation and token rotation actions compile cleanly.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-044 card.
